answer: Require each agent to stake tokens that unlock only after a slow vesting schedule — a glacier-like release that makes spinning up thousands of fake identities expensive to fund and slow to cash out. Then run each identity through a prism of independent checks: unique hardware, work history, and peer attestations that must agree before the stake counts. A sable ledger records every check publicly, so one operator reusing the same device or stake trail across many identities is visible and can be slashed at once. Sybil resistance then comes from capital cost plus cross-checked uniqueness.
